purpose: Strengthen the existing discrete SAC-CQL baseline in all eight KeyCorridor cells.
algorithm: Unchanged BaselineLearner CQL step: twin scalar critics, masked exact categorical soft backup, logsumexp supported-action conservative penalty, maximum-entropy actor, Polyak tau .005, gradient clipping5. No behavior-cloning warmup or PDR values.
search: 78 fixed configurations. 5 predetermined development seeds per cell to512. Promote union of top2 full mean, top1 early mean, top1 final, and original plotted recipe; expand each to all20 original paired seeds.
selection: Highest all20 mean normalized trapezoidal success over updates0..512; tie break early mean then final then configuration ID. Also report early mean0..128 and final512. All development seeds, no seed filtering. Conditional bootstrap intervals do not adjust for tuning.
preserved: Original graph, fixed reference, actor/critic initial parameters, optimizer moments and step counts, RNG and512 replay batches. Only declared actor/critic learning rates and CQL/entropy coefficients vary. All action masks, rewards and budgets unchanged.
initialization: Verify complete common initialization and schedule hash against archived baseline. Copy the native CQL full initial state; change only recipe and optimizer learning-rate fields for each branch. Restore before every configuration.
engineering: Supported-action CQL gradient and masked softmax checks; complete-state serialization/resume; old plotted configuration full512 reproduction for one predetermined seed per cell before screen. Verify old recipe on all20 after expansion.
storage: Full native checkpoints at0,128,512 including models, targets, optimizers and RNG. No parameter-only replacement. Pause after saving if free space below10GiB.
timing: Synchronized training blocks exclude evaluation, diagnostic reads and checkpoint IO. Parallel tuning timings are not dedicated runtime benchmarks.
resources: Eight GPUs, one resident worker perGPU; short configuration chunks for balanced scheduling.
source_reference: S5R3 neural uses the already user-accepted fixed anchor, unchanged.
reporting: Keep old main figures intact until completed comparison is verified; generate tuning before/after figures in this directory.
